tasks.name: Fleet Target Sweep (3 Drones)
tasks.content: Three-drone target sweep: Drone 4, Drone 3, and Drone 2 take off together to 17 meters altitude. Drone 4 flies to target Polygon Target 1, Drone 3 flies to target Circle Target 1, and Drone 2 flies to target Circle Target 2. After reaching the targets, all three drones move west for 67m, then south for 54m, then north for 53m together. Each drone must complete the specified directional movements (west 67m, south 54m, north 53m) regardless of starting position - if obstacles block the path, drones should adjust position as needed to complete the full directed distance in each heading.
content_aliases: Coordinate Drone 4, Drone 3, and Drone 2: ascend together to 17 meters altitude, send Drone 4 to target Polygon Target 1, Drone 3 to target Circle Target 1, and Drone 2 to target Circle Target 2, then execute coordinated sweep movement west 67m, south 54m, and north 53m. All drones must complete the full directional distance (west 67m, south 54m, north 53m) from their respective positions, adjusting as needed to avoid obstacles.

Three-drone target sweep operation: launch Drone 4, Drone 3, and Drone 2 to altitude 17m, navigate to targets Polygon Target 1, Circle Target 1, Circle Target 2 respectively, then shift west by 67 meters, south by 54 meters, and north by 53 meters in synchronized operation. Each drone travels the specified distance in each direction regardless of obstacles encountered.

Execute three-drone sweep mission: Drone 4, Drone 3, Drone 2 take off reaching 17 meters height, fly to targets Polygon Target 1, Circle Target 1, Circle Target 2 respectively, then proceed west for 67m, subsequently south for 54m, and finally north for 53m together, with each drone completing the full directed movements by repositioning around obstacles if necessary.

Three-drone coordinated target mission: Drone 4, Drone 3, and Drone 2 lift off to 17m elevation, reach targets Polygon Target 1, Circle Target 1, Circle Target 2 respectively, then travel west 67 meters, south 54 meters, and north 53 meters in sequence. The specified directional distances must be achieved by each drone, adapting position to circumvent any obstacles.
